dossier.headline: Whirlpool of India's Q2 profit falls 39%
dossier.summary: Whirlpool of India reported Q2 FY27 consolidated net profit of about ₹25 crore, down 39% from about ₹41 crore a year earlier, even as revenue rose about 14% to ₹1,873 crore. Reports attribute the fall to higher operating costs and margin compression, continuing a weak trend after a roughly 30% profit fall in Q1 FY27.
why_it_matters: Shows cost pressure on consumer-durables makers despite revenue growth
Second straight quarter of sharply lower profit
watch: The share's reaction when markets reopen on Wednesday
questions: Is the margin squeeze from input costs or from pricing pressure?
conflicts: Reports give the year-ago profit as about ₹41 crore (a 39% fall); one filing summary uses a different base and a smaller decline
